# MOA GitHub Copilot Instructions

When generating code for MOA (Spring Boot 3 + Flutter):
- Always refer to `@AGENTS.md` and `@AI_RULES.md` for team rules.
- Backend code must be clean Spring Boot 3 with proper validation and DTO mapping.
- Frontend code must be clean Flutter/Dart with Riverpod/Provider state management.
- Do not invent fake API endpoints; follow `@openapi.yaml`.
